look: Session board on a dot-grid desk: scattered route files with lonely checks, one panel collecting every route rule, nested paths lighting up to the deepest, two decision arrows for 401 and 403, and the kavach end card. Plain. Colors and type from the Zen-Sumi design system: washi paper, sumi ink, rationed vermillion for what is wrong, jade for what is right.
